subject: Control Evidence: SCIM delta timeline and RBAC ownership walkthrough
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@medilink.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: security@medilink.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership artifacts for SIG assessment

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for making time on short notice. As part of our SIG review we need a compact set of artifacts showing the cumulative SCIM delta for your tenant over the past 90 days, plus an RBAC ownership map for accounts with elevated privileges (service accounts, admins, delegated roles).

Specifically we are looking for: 
- A SCIM delta CSV (timestamped adds/updates/deletes) that includes user/email, operation, actor, and change timestamp.
- SAML assertion samples for a handful of recent logins (to validate attribute mapping).
- An RBAC owner matrix that ties roles to human owners and approval dates.
- Evidence of least-privilege reviews or role pruning in the last 6 months (meeting notes, PRs, or audit snapshots).

Our timeline is tight: can we get these artifacts by EOD Thursday (Feb 12)? If not, confirm a target and any blockers. Also please indicate whether any artifacts contain PII so we can coordinate a redaction plan.

Best,
Claire
Security Assurance Lead
MediLink Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@medilink.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership artifacts for SIG assessment

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the requested artifacts on the timeline with a short caveat: two items (SAML assertion samples and session snapshots) include email addresses and will need minimal redaction prior to sharing. I propose the following plan:

1) Today (Feb 10): I will pull the SCIM delta CSV and RBAC owner matrix and drop them into a shared folder (redaction not required).
2) Tomorrow (Feb 11 morning): Rishi will confirm commercial redaction boundaries and approvals for sharing assertion samples.
3) Feb 12 EOD: We will deliver SAML assertion examples and session snapshots (redacted) plus a short narrative that explains how our SCIM delta is generated and how role ownership is maintained.

Attachments we plan to include: scim-delta-2026-02.csv (CSV), rbac-owner-matrix-202602.xlsx (Excel), saml-assertion-samples-2026-02.txt (text), session-snapshots-202602.log.gz (log).

ETA note: the SCIM delta file will be an extract from our provisioning service and includes a "performed_by" field (system/service-account) that links to the actor identity. If you need the full actor chain (e.g., OAuth client ids) we can include that as a separate mapping.

I'll upload the initial artifacts to the Drive folder and share the link once the files are staged.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, GRC & Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@medilink.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership artifacts for SIG assessment

Claire / Vanessa —

Quick commercial note: MediLink's SIG intake indicates that the evidence delivery milestone is tied to the quarter-end contract review (Deal DEAL-3421). I can fast-track approvals for the redaction scope if it helps meet your timeline; just confirm which fields need masking (full emails vs. local-part only).

Also attaching a short checklist for the procurement team so they can mark off the compliance handoff (DocuSign and HubSpot references included).

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf - stub)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Claire Ng <claire.ng@medilink.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership artifacts for SIG assessment

Vanessa —

Thanks for the plan. Two asks from my side: 
1) Please surface any service accounts that have ownerless mappings (we saw a brief spike during the January rollout). If there are ownerless accounts, include the remediation ticket IDs or PR links.
2) Add a one-paragraph summary at the top of the RBAC matrix describing the TTL for role approvals and the last certification date.

We should avoid sharing raw logs unless absolutely necessary — sample assertions and an explanatory narrative will usually be enough for SIG reviewers.

—Jonas
VP, Product & Security Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@medilink.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership artifacts for SIG assessment

Claire —

Files uploaded to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f
Deliverables included (short descriptions):
- scim-delta-2026-02.csv — 90-day delta extract, columns: ts, op, user.email (redacted), actor, resource_id. No PII present beyond email addresses (redacted with ***@example.com).
- rbac-owner-matrix-202602.xlsx — Role -> Owner -> Last certified date -> TTL -> Notes (one-paragraph summary on sheet1).
- saml-assertion-samples-2026-02.txt — Four recent assertions with attributes redacted for email local-part.
- session-snapshots-202602.log.gz — Two sample sessions; timestamps only, email fields redacted.

Notes on ownerless accounts: We identified three service accounts with missing owners (svc-analytics-3, svc-legacy-sync-01, svc-sftp-proxy). Remediation tickets are linked in the RBAC sheet (JIRA-CR-821, JIRA-CR-822, JIRA-CR-823).

If you need expanded actor chains or raw, unredacted logs under an NDA, we can arrange a secure transfer. Otherwise, this package should suffice for SIG and SOC2 reviewers.

Thanks — reach out if anything else is needed.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, GRC & Customer Security
Redwood Inference
(attachments: scim-delta-2026-02.csv; rbac-owner-matrix-202602.xlsx; saml-assertion-samples-2026-02.txt; session-snapshots-202602.log.gz)
